subject.title: All LLM API calls time out simultaneously despite APIs being reachable (multi-agent concurrency issue)

question: Should the remaining work stay scoped to this Telegram multi-agent timeout report, or be folded into a broader lane-starvation/provider-timeout canonical investigation?
rationale: Current main has partial fallback mitigations, but the remaining proposals span Telegram runner concurrency, Node launch defaults, provider timeout semantics, and new config knobs, so automation should not choose the product boundary.

options.title: Keep as live-repro tracking

options.title: Declare mitigated by fallback fixes
